sources.entry: Blink Eye - An Open-Source minimalist Eye Care reminder & Break Timer app for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

summary.one_liner: Blink Eye is a minimalist eye-care and break-timer desktop app built with Tauri that reminds you to look away from the screen using full-screen popups.
summary.what_it_does: The app runs customizable reminder timers and shows full-screen popups with a 20-second countdown prompting the user to look away, following the 20-20-20 rule. It offers a library of reminder screens and a settings dashboard for preferences. It tracks usage time with daily, weekly, and lifetime stats. The README lists multilingual support, audio muting during reminders, and workday scheduling as upcoming ("Soon") features. The README also describes a companion website in a separate folder that can be run locally with Bun.
use_cases: reduce eye strain during long screen sessions
notable: Full-screen 20-second look-away popups based on the 20-20-20 rule
Usage time tracking with daily, weekly, and lifetime stats
Separate marketing website in a website/ folder
caveats: Audio mute, multilingual support, and workday scheduling are marked as upcoming ('Soon')
Building from source requires installing Tauri, Rust, Cargo, and Bun
Commercial use requires a separate paid license from the author
